onboarding.introText: These details are used only for compatibility evaluation. You can go back and edit them at any time.
onboarding.step1: What degree would you like to pursue?
onboarding.step2: Tell us about your academic background
onboarding.step4: Where would you like to study?
onboarding.gpaNote: Different scales are not assumed to be equivalent.
onboarding.notTaken: I have not taken this test
onboarding.examNote: You can continue without scores. Requirement status will be shown separately.
onboarding.countryNote: If no country is chosen, all available countries will be considered.
onboarding.costNote: Budget is compared with tuition only; living costs need separate assessment.
onboarding.validation: Choose a degree and field to continue.
onboarding.catalogCount: There are {count} verified programs for these choices.
onboarding.catalogNone: There are no verified programs for these choices yet. You can browse the university directory.
onboarding.customMajor: Enter your major as written on your degree
onboarding.catalogAvailabilityNote: Only source-backed degree programs appear in matching. A university can be listed even when its programs are still being checked.

results.title: Programs for you
results.subtitle: This score shows compatibility with available program information. It is not an admission guarantee.
results.emptyHelp: Verified program coverage is still limited. Browse the university directory or change your country and field choices.
results.catalog_empty: There are no programs in the catalog yet.
results.degree_unavailable: No source-backed program for this degree is in the catalog yet.
results.field_unavailable: No source-backed program for this field and degree is in the catalog yet.
results.country_unavailable: No source-backed program in the selected countries is in the catalog yet.
results.university_unavailable: The selected university has no verified program for this field and degree yet.
results.filters_empty: The current filters hide all results. Clear the filters to see them.
results.custom_field_unmapped: Your custom major is saved, but it has not been mapped to the catalog. Try a related catalog field or browse universities.
results.insufficient_data: There is not enough verified program data for this selection yet.

matchNotes.requirements_unverified: Admission requirements are unverified or unavailable.
matchNotes.gpa_scale_mismatch: GPA scales differ; no conversion was assumed.
matchNotes.language_score_missing: Language score is missing; a waiver may be possible.
matchNotes.finance_missing: Tuition or budget is unavailable; living costs are excluded.
matchNotes.scholarship_required_unverified: Funding has not been verified for your full scholarship requirement.
matchNotes.program_specific_prerequisites: Program-specific prior study requirements need individual review.
matchNotes.subject_prerequisites_unverified: A related subject does not establish admission eligibility.
matchNotes.hsk_not_demonstrated: HSK requirement has not been demonstrated.
matchNotes.english_cefr_not_demonstrated: English CEFR level has not been demonstrated.
matchNotes.finance_not_comparable: Tuition and annual budget cannot be compared with the available data.
